payload.core_composition_summary: DP counts ways to partition; greedy choice of max suffix minimizes number of substrings.
payload.rationale: Solution uses 1D DP for number of ways (dp array) and greedy for min splits (dp1 array) based on precomputed max valid lengths. Both mechanisms coordinate to output required three values.
